description: Imports accounting entities (customers, invoices, bills, payments, journal entries, items, taxes, vendors, employees, etc.) from a QuickBooks Online company.

baseUrl.resolution: Chosen at runtime from the boolean endpoint config field `is_sandbox`: https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com (production) or https://sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com (sandbox). The company/realm id is then a path segment: /v3/company/{realm_id}/...

spec.apiVersionPinning: Two layers: major version as a path segment (`/v3/`) and a minor version as a query parameter (`minorversion=75`) sent on every query request.

credentialModes.name: Intuit OAuth2 app (user-registered) with rotating refresh token

configFields.name: realm_id
configFields.description: QuickBooks realm/company id; kept as a string because the numeric value is large enough to lose precision. Used as a path segment.

configFields.name: credentials.client_id
configFields.description: Client id of the user's own Intuit app.

configFields.name: credentials.client_secret
configFields.description: Client secret of the user's own Intuit app.

configFields.name: credentials.refresh_token
configFields.description: Refresh token issued by the user's app; rotated by the connector and written back to the endpoint config.

configFields.name: credentials.access_token
configFields.description: Hidden field (x-hidden-field) defaulted to the literal "PLACEHOLDER"; populated by the connector at startup, not by the user.

configFields.name: credentials.access_token_expires_at
configFields.description: Hidden field defaulted to the epoch; maintained by the connector.

configFields.name: start_date
configFields.description: Backfill floor; defaults to 30 days before the present, constrained to be >= 1970-01-01.

configFields.name: is_sandbox
configFields.description: Selects the sandbox host instead of production. Default false.

configFields.name: name
configFields.description: Name of this resource (generic CDK ResourceConfig).

configFields.name: interval
configFields.description: ISO-8601 duration between updates for this resource; the connector seeds every binding with PT5M.

authTierRationale: Exactly one credential mode is offered and it is the hardest kind. The credentials class deliberately omits the `x-oauth2-provider` annotation (the source comment says this makes the UI collect the app's credentials directly instead of offering an OAuth login against a shared Estuary app), and the spec snapshot confirms client_id, client_secret and refresh_token are all user-required secrets. The connector's own error message tells the user to register an app at developer.intuit.com and supply an unexpired refresh token issued by it. There is no hosted-control-plane fallback and no API-key mode, so the standalone tier is T3_BYO_REFRESH. Refresh tokens rotate: the connector exchanges at startup and writes any new refresh_token back into the endpoint config (a comment notes QuickBooks refresh tokens, unlike most sources', stay reusable for a prolonged period, so the rotation is forgiving rather than single-use).

unionMisfits.description: QuickBooks Online paginates INSIDE the query language, not in HTTP params. The connector interpolates `STARTPOSITION <offset> MAXRESULTS 1000` into the SQL-like statement text and advances offset by the page size, terminating when a page yields fewer than 1000 records. There is no offsetParam/limitParam to name, so the v2.1 offset paginator does not fit; the PullSpec kind `query` also has no paginator slot in the schema. Both facts are recorded in querySketch instead. Forcing {"type":"offset","offsetParam":"STARTPOSITION"} would be actively misleading: a consumer would send it as an HTTP query parameter and silently re-read page one forever.

The backfill leg is not a plain historical sweep: it is a time-sliced resumable scan whose page cursor is a TIMESTAMP (the last-seen MetaData.LastUpdatedTime, ISO-8601 to second precision), not an offset or opaque token. It also self-interrupts on a wall-clock budget of ~5 minutes per fetch_page invocation, checkpointing at a second boundary so a partially-consumed second is never split. PullSpec has nowhere to express either the timestamp-valued page cursor or the time-budgeted yield.

The incremental window's upper bound is deliberately held back from now() by a 30-second settling delay so the cursor only ever advances over a fully-visible state of the source, and the cursor value is taken from record metadata rather than the local clock. The schema's `incrementalParam` cannot express a watermark lag or a bounded (lower AND upper) window.
Version pinning is split across two mechanisms at once (path segment /v3 plus a minorversion=75 query parameter); the field is a single string so both are described in prose.

abstained.streams[*].pull.*.paginator: Pagination is expressed as STARTPOSITION/MAXRESULTS keywords inside the query TEXT, not as HTTP parameters. No member of the Paginator union describes that, and emitting an `offset` paginator would produce a silently-truncating consumer. Recorded in unionMisfits[0] and in querySketch instead.
abstained.execution.defaultSchedule: There is no connector-wide schedule in the source; the 5-minute cadence is set per binding via ResourceConfig.interval, so it is recorded on each stream rather than here.
abstained.streams[*].pull.*.incrementalParam: The time bounds are not a request parameter; they are literal predicates embedded in the query text, so `incrementalParam` (param + format) has no correct value.
abstained.streams[*].writeDisposition: Not stated in the connector. Inferred as `merge` from the collection key /Id combined with an incremental leg that re-emits updated entities; the connector never emits deletes (QuickBooks deletes/voids would arrive only as updated entities, and the CDC endpoint that could report them is explicitly declined), so it is not snapshot_with_tombstone.
abstained.credentialModes[0].scheme.scopes: Only `com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting` appears, in the authorization URL template. Whether an Intuit app must also carry openid/profile scopes for the flow to complete is not determinable from this repository.
abstained.transports[0].spec.baseUrl.template: Modelled as `resolved` rather than `template` because the two hosts are distinct constants selected by a boolean, not one string with a substituted placeholder.
